item.title: Observing Kubernetes Network Connections with Kindling
item.description: I recently had a requirement to collect Kubernetes’ external network access. So I set up and tried out some related projects. This post is mainly about how to install Kindling and configure Grafana to view Kubernetes network connection data. 1. What Is Kindling Kindling solves the problem of how to observe the network without intruding on the application; its functionality is mainly achieved by exposing kernel events for observation.
